Lina H: Hey team, new contractor Ben needs visa sponsorship checklist clarified. He's currently on CPT expiring 2026-07-15 and starts as IC on 06/01. What do we need to collect before first invoice?
Omar R: for contractors we still need I-9 docs if they're working in the US. But sponsorship (H-1B) is separate and handled when/if we convert to employee. For now collect passport and CPT EAD or I-20 + CPT auth.
Ben S: I have current CPT on I-20, employer letter from university, and passport. I'll upload. Do contractors get benefits while on CPT?
Lina H: contractors do not get full benefits. Please see policy: contractors >90 days are eligible for some stipends, but only employees go through benefits enrollment.
visa-bot: Reminder: Upload documents to /hr-onboarding within 5 business days to avoid contract hold. Link: https://redwood.example.com/onboard
Omar R: also flag in the contractor record that we may convert to FTE; keeps recruiting loop informed. If conversion happens, we'll need full I-9 + any EAD card copies or H-1B docs.
Ben S: uploading now. Quick Q: if I transition to H-1B later, do you sponsor from contractor status?
Lina H: we can sponsor at conversion but need to follow H-1B cap and timing. People Ops + Legal will advise. For now, ensure contract contains clause about sponsorship eligibility.
Omar R: action items: @Ben S upload passport + CPT docs; @Lina H confirm contractor benefits eligibility in system; @Recruiting to note potential sponsorship.
Ben S: done uploading. thanks! :thumbsup:
